title: Standard CVRP inter-route 2-opt* (tail exchange)
summary: Breaks one edge in each of two CVRP routes and cross-reconnects their tails (normal or reversed) when prefix+suffix loads satisfy capacity Q.

applicable_regimes.scale_notes: 单次 O(1) 校验（借助每条路径预计算的前缀需求数组）即可整体交换两条相交路径的尾部，比逐点 relocate 更直接解开双路径交叉。

interface_blueprint.skeleton_role: 为每条路径维护前缀和需求数组 pref_load；对任意两条不同路径 (r_a, r_b) 枚举断点 (i, j)，O(1) 判断顺接 (head_a + tail_b, head_b + tail_a) 与反接 (head_a + rev(head_b), rev(tail_a) + tail_b) 的容量与路程增量
invariants_and_constraints: 顺接容量：pref_a[i] + (tot_b - pref_b[j]) <= Q 且 pref_b[j] + (tot_a - pref_a[i]) <= Q
反接容量：pref_a[i] + pref_b[j] <= Q 且 (tot_a - pref_a[i]) + (tot_b - pref_b[j]) <= Q
若产生空路径则直接移除实现车数缩减
typical_pitfalls: 遗漏对称 CVRP 下的反接方向（头接反转头 + 尾接反转尾），丢失一半可行解
修改路径后未刷新 prefix_loads 导致容量越界

math_formulation.expr: Delta_direct = d(a_i, b_{j+1}) + d(b_j, a_{i+1}) - d(a_i, a_{i+1}) - d(b_j, b_{j+1})

variables.(a_i, a_{i+1}): 路径 A 断开的边
variables.(b_j, b_{j+1}): 路径 B 断开的边

math_formulation.preconditions: 顺接重连：pref_load(A,i) + suff_load(B,j+1) <= Q 且 pref_load(B,j) + suff_load(A,i+1) <= Q

math_formulation.expr: Delta_rev = d(a_i, b_j) + d(a_{i+1}, b_{j+1}) - d(a_i, a_{i+1}) - d(b_j, b_{j+1})
math_formulation.preconditions: 对称距离下反接重连：pref_load(A,i) + pref_load(B,j) <= Q 且 suff_load(A,i+1) + suff_load(B,j+1) <= Q
